items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: Interviewee compares Manuel Perez's style to Bolden's ('Would their style be alike? ... Yeah, they'd be different') but does not claim personal interaction or direct collaboration with Bolden.

ctx.x: Uh, who was the best? For reading. Oh, Manuel Perez.
Manuel Perez. Yes, indeed. Well, would he play with the same tone as Bolden and Clem?
No, no, he had his own band.
